title: Python: pin GCLI-144's untested conditions: the lazy-read bindings.length > 0 check and the decorator-site removal (test only)
description: Test-only task, ordinary, not hold, ordered FIRST ahead of GCLI-146 by DEC-303 (a75) item 2 (GCLI-146 works in the same lookupBindings area, so the fixture should protect the condition before anyone edits it). Test files only, no change to src/python/calls.ts, no review round: opum-doc reads by ref that the delta is test-only. Follow-up from GCLI-144's round 2 (opum-ai/glyph-cli#223, landed 02043cd). Fixtures: N1a and N1b (below) pin the 'lazyDiffers && bindings.length > 0' condition in lookupBindings ONLY (the mutant that drops '&& bindings.length > 0' leaves every GCLI-144 fixture green today and must turn red on them). They are GCLI-146's behaviour cases: GCLI-146 (DEC-303 (a76)) folds N1a and N1b in and will turn them from 'unchanged from dev' into REFUSED, so write them to be updated by GCLI-146, with a comment saying so. Also add the N2 removal as a fixture. STEP 1 REPRODUCERS (run on origin/dev, runtime answers from CPython 3.15.2, plain python3): N1a: m.py def len(o): pass; app.py class Outer: type A = len([]); from m import len. dev: external 1, no edge (claims the builtin len); runtime: Outer.A.__value__ is m.len. N1b: s.py def f(): pass; m.py def f(): pass; app.py from s import *; class Outer: type A = f(); from m import f. dev: edge app.py:3:14 to s.py:f; runtime: m.f. N2: m.py class X: pass; app.py def outer(): def staticmethod(f): return f; class Outer: @staticmethod; def m(self): self.n(); def n(self): pass; from m import X as staticmethod. dev: edge app.py:5:10 to outer.staticmethod; runtime: the builtin staticmethod is read, outer.staticmethod is never called (the GCLI-144 head removes this edge; no task, (a76) item 3). N1a and N1b are wrong on dev and are folded into GCLI-146 by DEC-303 (a76) (no separate hold task). Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: N1a and N1b fixtures measured against origin/dev and the head by running both (identical), and the mutant that drops bindings.length > 0 observed red on them
The N2 fixture asserts the removed decorator-site edge and the surviving self.n() edge, red on origin/dev, green at the head
No change to src/python/calls.ts; five-pin cmp identical
